articles.title: Crypto may have institutionalized, but it still trades like a rumor mill
articles.snippet: The more institutional crypto becomes, the more it prices on headlines. The edge now is reading the positioning data underneath, not reacting to the narrative on top.

articles.title: SpaceX extends decline to 11% on lockup expiration and capex spending fears
articles.snippet: The company reported no BTC sales in the second quarter, but shares fell before the open as investors focused on capital spending, free cash flow pressure and a looming insider lockup expiry.

articles.title: Circle shares fall 3% despite earnings beat as stablecoin issuer misses on revenue
articles.snippet: Shares initially jumped 10% but later fell 3% in pre-market trading as the stablecoin issuer revealed institutional adoption for its layer 1 blockchain Arc but missed on revenue.

articles.title: Coldcard hack sparks a self-custody security overhaul: Cory Klippsten
articles.snippet: The attack exposed a five-year-old firmware flaw. The industry’s rapid response is accelerating the adoption of collaborative multisig security.

articles.title: New Ethereum proposal would cut issuance to zero if staked ETH reaches $112 billion
articles.snippet: The EIP-8361 draft proposal calls for burning a rising share of validator rewards as the staking ratio climbs.
